notes: Frozen web is the exact active installation interface and is the release reference.
Frontend source comes from server/ui-source/apps/web; backend packages come from the actual installation, not its older ui-source package duplicates.
custom-ui-source contains archived pure UI customization code; the older style-picker injection is superseded by ProductSetPicker.tsx.
The historical desktop source declares assembly version 0.1.16.0 despite the release version 0.1.18; byte-for-byte native rebuild has not been established.
Native branding uses the active installation workbench.ico and logo-transparent.png. Both reachable frozen web logo filenames and apps/web source logo contain the same active purple branding image.
Historical customization build scripts retain their original installation-relative layout and are archival; they are not the default source or release build.
Publication integration adds README, private archive notice, preserved UI verification/build entry and CI; npm build:source retains the historical editable frontend build.
Git attributes preserve exact file bytes across checkouts, including the frozen assets and historical source line endings.
